notes.title: Idle Awakening Demo: Tiny Update v0.1.4j
notes.content:
QoL Improvements:
- Added autopurchase for resources in shop.
- Added possibility to view maxed out actions.
 Bug Fixes 
- Fixed a bug where "ON/OFF" flag under automations was displayed incorrectly.

notes.title: Idle Awakening Demo: Tiny Update v0.1.4i
notes.content:
The aim of this small update is to address some bugs reported by players recently.

v0.1.4i Patch Notes
Bug Fixes
- The window state is now saved properly — the game no longer always opens in fullscreen.
- Fixed a bug where "Perform Basic Tricks" was incorrectly affected by the physical actions discount.
- Fixed a display issue where the potential resource balance shown in the left sidebar could be incorrect.
Balance Changes
- Increased basic values of crafting and alchemy effort
